correctness.rationale: Odd cyclic incidence determinant 2 and strict cap positivity establish a single standard simplex of missing points; half-integrality gives the unique nonintegral vertex. At dilations k the inverse-lattice parity is exactly total slack congruent to k modulo 2; summing stars-and-bars produces the formula. A nonzero pole at -1 proves minimum period 2. Standalone exact enumeration checked 47 integer dilation cases and simplex vertices. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.
